description: Resource type definition for AWS::EC2::Image (read-only). Represents an existing Amazon Machine Image (AMI) and supports Read and List for referencing AMIs in templates and for inventory/compliance coverage. AMI provisioning is intentionally out of scope: AMIs are long-lived, built through a multi-step process, and their create APIs can run for days, which does not fit a CloudFormation stack lifecycle. Every field returned by DescribeImages is modelled so a Read of any AMI (encrypted, Windows, paravirtual, Outpost, etc.) conforms to the schema.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AMI.

RootDeviceName.description: The device name of the root device volume.

RootDeviceType.description: The type of root device used by the AMI.

VirtualizationType.description: The type of virtualization of the AMI.

Hypervisor.description: The hypervisor type of the AMI.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the AWS account that owns the AMI.

ImageOwnerAlias.description: The owner alias (amazon, aws-backup-vault, or aws-marketplace).

Public.description: Whether the AMI has public launch permissions.

EnaSupport.description: Whether enhanced networking with ENA is enabled.

SriovNetSupport.description: Whether enhanced networking with the Intel 82599 VF interface is enabled.

BootMode.description: The boot mode of the AMI.

KernelId.description: The ID of the kernel (paravirtual images).

RamdiskId.description: The ID of the RAM disk (paravirtual images).

PlatformDetails.description: The platform details associated with the billing code of the AMI.

UsageOperation.description: The operation of the AMI for usage billing.

Platform.description: The operating system platform (e.g. Windows), when applicable.

State.description: The current state of the AMI.

CreationDate.description: The date and time the AMI was created.

DeprecationTime.description: The date and time the AMI is set to be deprecated, as returned by DescribeImages.

LastLaunchedTime.description: The most recent date and time the AMI was used to launch an instance.

DeregistrationProtection.description: The deregistration protection state of the AMI.

SourceImageId.description: The ID of the source AMI, if applicable.

SourceImageRegion.description: The Region of the source AMI, if applicable.

SourceInstanceId.description: For an AMI created from an instance, the ID of the source instance.

PublicSsmParameterName.description: The name of a public SSM parameter that points to this AMI, if applicable.

ImageAllowed.description: Whether the AMI is allowed under Allowed AMIs settings.

FreeTierEligible.description: Whether the AMI is eligible for the AWS Free Tier.

BlockDeviceMappings.description: The block device mappings of the AMI.

ProductCodes.description: Any product codes associated with the AMI.

ImageWatermarks.description: The image watermarks associated with the AMI.

Tags.description: Any tags assigned to the AMI.
